items.question: What distinguishes the yogis' attainment of essence from the scholars' mere consumption?
premises: Essence and buttermilk represent superior and inferior portions of the same source.
items.inference: Direct yogic realization attains the essential truth, while mere scholarship remains with its derivative residue.
items.plain_english: The yogis have drunk the essence, but the scholars drink the buttermilk.
